The '''father''' of [[Tessala Corvae]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|general]] who had gained notoriety during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was a member of a long line of military [[Officer/Legends|officers]], and his influence led to the admission of his daughter into the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] on [[Carida/Legends|Carida]].<ref name="LOTE" />
